selected_bottleneck: mission-list-durable-id-binding-integrity（使命列表持久化 ID 绑定完整性）
selected_problem: Fresh canonical main made AutonomousMissionStore.get fail closed on storage/body id mismatch, but AutonomousMissionStore.list still parsed mission JSON files directly. The scheduler consumes list() and then calls tick(mission.id), so a forged in-document id could bypass the new read boundary and turn an active durable mission into a silently unschedulable identity.（最新主分支已让 AutonomousMissionStore.get 在存储/文档 ID 不匹配时失败关闭，但 AutonomousMissionStore.list 仍直接解析 mission JSON；调度器消费 list() 后按 mission.id 调用 tick，因此伪造内部 id 可绕过新读取边界，并把真实存在的活动使命变成身份错误、无法正常调度的对象。）
decision_basis: The newly merged main already establishes get() as the durable mission identity boundary, so routing list through get closes a bypass without adding architecture.（刚合并的主分支已经把 get() 建立为持久化 mission 身份边界，因此让 list 复用 get 只是闭合绕过路径，不增加架构。）
The list path feeds the autonomous scheduler directly, making this a real autonomous-loop integrity defect rather than a cosmetic listing inconsistency.（列表路径直接供自主调度器使用，因此这是真实的自主循环完整性缺陷，而不是纯展示问题。）
changes: Make AutonomousMissionStore.list derive each mission id from the durable filename and load through AutonomousMissionStore.get.（AutonomousMissionStore.list 从持久化文件名推导 mission id，并通过 AutonomousMissionStore.get 加载。）
Add focused regressions proving forged list entries fail closed while intact missions remain listable.（新增回归，证明伪造列表条目失败关闭，同时完整 mission 仍可列出。）
